grammar.summary: 本课学习引语与时态搭配（news 场景）。

points.title: 直接引语转间接引语复现
points.explanation: 'The macaroni is growing well' → He said (that) the macaroni was growing well. 时态回移三规则综合运用。

examples.en: He said the harvest was always excellent.

points.title: 现在完成时表刚发生（新闻）
points.explanation: has just been harvested 新闻时态：完成时表"已发生+有结果"。

examples.en: The crop has been harvested this year.
examples.cn: 今年的庄稼已经收获了。
